notes: 20-item bank. CAPS mix: 5 L1 / 8 L2 / 7 L3. Rates: R/kg, R/L, L/100km, km/h. SA contexts: Pick n Pay grocery, petrol consumption, taxi vs Uber, biltong stalls.

stimulus.inline: A rate compares two different quantities, e.g. R/kg means Rand per kilogram.

items.question: If 2 kg of apples costs R30, what is the rate in R/kg?

stimulus.inline: Petrol consumption rate is measured in litres per 100 km (L/100km).

items.question: A car uses 8 L of petrol to travel 100 km. What is its consumption rate?
workingSteps: Direct reading: 8 L per 100 km = 8 L/100km.

stimulus.inline: Speed is the rate of distance per unit time.

items.question: A minibus travels 240 km in 4 hours. Calculate its average speed.

stimulus.inline: Wage rates are expressed as Rand per hour.

items.question: A casual worker earns R720 for an 8-hour shift. Calculate her hourly rate.

stimulus.inline: A simple R/kg rate compares the price of the same product at different shops.

items.question: Spar sells potatoes at R36 for 3 kg. Calculate the price per kg.

stimulus.inline:
**Boxer Superstore — sugar prices**

| Pack | Price |
|---|---|
| 1 kg | R22,50 |
| 2,5 kg | R52,50 |

items.question: Which pack is cheaper per kg?
options: Both are the same price per kg
workingSteps: R21,00 < R22,50, so the 2,5 kg pack is cheaper per kg.

stimulus.inline: Two cars are compared. Car A: 50 L for 500 km. Car B: 40 L for 500 km.

items.question: Which car has the better fuel consumption (lower L/100km)?

stimulus.inline: Petrol costs R23,50 per litre. A car uses 60 L to fill up.

items.question: Calculate the total cost of the tank.

stimulus.inline: Three stalls sell biltong. Stall A: R85 for 250 g. Stall B: R150 for 500 g. Stall C: R270 for 1 kg.

items.question: Which stall sells biltong at the lowest price per kg?

stimulus.inline: A delivery driver covers 270 km in 4,5 hours.

items.question: Calculate his average speed.

stimulus.inline: A factory worker earns R85 per hour and worked 38 hours last week.

items.question: Calculate the worker's gross wage for the week.

stimulus.inline: A taxi charges R12 per km. A passenger travels 6,5 km.

items.question: Calculate the fare.

stimulus.inline: A water meter reads 12 320 L at the start of a month and 13 760 L at month-end.

items.question: What is the average daily water consumption for a 30-day month?

stimulus.inline: A car has a consumption of 7,5 L/100km. The trip from Cape Town to Worcester is 110 km. Petrol costs R24,00/L.

items.question: Calculate the petrol cost for the one-way trip.

stimulus.inline: Uber charges R12/km. A regular metered taxi charges a flat R20 base + R8/km.

items.question: For a 10 km trip, which is cheaper and by how much?

stimulus.inline:
**Pick n Pay sunflower oil — pack sizes**

| Pack | Price |
|---|---|
| 750 ml | R44,99 |
| 2 L | R109,99 |
| 5 L | R269,99 |

items.question: Which pack offers the lowest price per litre?

stimulus.inline: A driver leaves Pretoria at 08:00 and arrives in Durban (587 km away) at 14:52, taking one 30-minute lunch break.

items.question: Calculate the average driving speed (excluding the lunch break).
workingSteps: Total clock time = 6 h 52 min = 6,87 h.

stimulus.inline: Eskom prepaid electricity costs R2,80/kWh in the first 350 kWh block. A geyser uses 4 kWh per day.

items.question: Calculate the monthly (30-day) electricity cost of the geyser at this rate.

stimulus.inline: A printer prints 24 pages per minute. A book has 320 pages.

items.question: How long (in minutes) does the printer take to print the book? Round to the nearest minute.

stimulus.inline: A 100 g serving of yoghurt contains 5 g of protein.

items.question: How many grams of protein are in a 250 g tub?

_error_signal_vocabulary.ERR_UNIT_PRICE_INVERSION: Divides quantity by price instead of price by quantity (or vice versa) when finding a unit rate.
_error_signal_vocabulary.ERR_RATE_COMPARE: Compares two rates without converting both to the same base (e.g. R/kg vs R/g).
_error_signal_vocabulary.ERR_RATE_USE_OPERATION: Uses the wrong operation when applying a known rate (multiplies when divide was needed, etc.).
_error_signal_vocabulary.ERR_SPEED_TIME_DISTANCE: Confuses the speed = distance ÷ time relationship.
_error_signal_vocabulary.ERR_TIME_HM_TO_DECIMAL: Treats hours and minutes as a decimal (6 h 52 min as 6,52 h instead of 6,87 h).
